text: Correction of the earlier job watch observation in the shared-expense-tracker pilot (e5dbe1f build): job watch did follow the retried PlanReview job to completion. What misled the agent is that inspectExecutionJob reports latestFailure as the newest attempt that ever failed, so a completed job (attempt 2 succeeded) still shows the attempt-1 failure with a retry decision of JOB_RESULT_ALREADY_ACCEPTED. latestFailure should be reported only when the newest attempt is the failed one.
